t: Video Transcript and Timeline Extractor: a plain-language overview (Signature)
title: Video Transcript and Timeline Extractor: a plain-language overview (Signature)
description: Signature record. Overview: what the Video Transcript and Timeline Extractor does and why archives need it. Signature original. The Signature timeline method never throws a source away: subtitles, transcripts, and chapter marks all survive as separate layers on one timeline, each stamped with where it came from. When sources disagree on timing, both timings are kept and the conflict is marked. The archive shows the disagreement honestly.
provenance: Signature-authored original method by Justin Addam Higgins (JAH). Property of Justin Addam Higgins.

t: How the Video Transcript and Timeline Extractor works (Signature)
title: How the Video Transcript and Timeline Extractor works (Signature)
description: Signature record. Overview: what the Video Transcript and Timeline Extractor does and why archives need it. Signature original. The Signature approach builds a layered cue ledger: layer one holds the original subtitle track untouched, layer two holds the fresh transcript with per-word timestamps, and layer three holds the merged reading order. A conflict ledger records every timing disagreement with both values and a deterministic resolution rule (subtitle timing wins for display, transcript timing wins for search), so the merge is reproducible and every decision is auditable. This is a Signature-authored method, original to Justin Addam Higgins.
provenance: Signature-authored original method by Justin Addam Higgins (JAH). Property of Justin Addam Higgins.
